fields.notes: Two risks moved to **mitigating** this week. The county pilot depends on the redaction service, now *at risk*.

fields.title: Offline sync conflicts lose inspector edits
fields.description: Because two inspectors can edit the same report offline, the later sync might overwrite the earlier one, which would lose findings.
fields.mitigation:
Field-level merge shipped in !218.

- Monitor conflict rate weekly
- Escalate if it passes 1%

fields.title: County IT blocks the photo upload domain
fields.description: County firewalls block unknown domains by default.
fields.mitigation: Ask both pilot counties to allowlist the domain before go-live.

fields.title: Inspectors have a phone with a camera
fields.description: Every county issues one; confirm for the pilot sites.

fields.title: Report export times out for reports with 200+ photos
fields.resolution: Batching uploads cut the median from 9 seconds to 2; large reports still slow.
